title: The same few repositories are opened over and over, and finding them takes a while (2026-10-29)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
I am almost always loading the same repos. To make it easier to use the editor, we should maintain a list of recently opened repos, and provide a way to star them so that we have a favourite list first.

This is a QOL fix rather than a deep problem to solve. But any regular user will have the same challenge. We switch between the same set of repos fairly often. Finding them can sometimes take a while.
